02-welcome-pack.verdict: The e4 centred card is a real step toward the guide, but it still has an explaining paragraph, rarity-coloured names, a heavy 'Take the pack' button and a bare close button with no X; the e1 full-screen slab is the exact pattern the guide deletes.

03-hub-floor.verdict: The hub floor is a readable playground but not a polished AAA screen: station labels are oversized and equal-weight, there is no clear primary action, and the corner text, test-build joke caption and cramped footer ignore the style guide.

04-stash-terminal.verdict: The title is now a clear 32px header and the subtitle clutter is gone, but the screen is still a dense tool dump with weak hierarchy, a stacked footer, and leftover template-style hint rows.
findings: P1 bottom strip: freebie kit bar, welcome toast, hint rows: Remove the toast. Merge the legend and junk hint into one 14px footer row. Make 'take the freebie kit' a filled --acc button, 20px text, 48px tall, with a --acc-ink label. Keep the bar on --ui-panel with only a 3px left accent tab.

P1 hierarchy across the whole card: Make credits the single 56px hero in --acc. Set xp and stash/bag in 16px --tx-2 with 24px gaps. Move sort, armory and trophies into a separate right-aligned group, apart from the filter tabs.

P1 type sizes: section labels, gun keys, item wheel, tactical belt: Set all read text to at least 16px f-cond 600, with section headers in one consistent 16px style. Delete the orphan 'guns' caption or move it into the belt header. Raise the gun key rows to 48px tall with 16px names.

P2 header block, top-left and top-right: Align the title and stats on one baseline. Put 24px between the header and the tab row. Dim the backdrop scrim to .80 so the hub title does not show. Draw the X at 40px with a --ui-line-hi border and a --tx-2 glyph.
P2 stash grid: Use a --ui-line border for every slot with a 3px bottom rarity bar only. Show 6 by 5 empty slots so the grid reads as inventory. Put counts in 16px --tx-1.

05-sector-page.verdict: the card shell, x and lime cta follow the guide, but the screen is a crowded settings form with a dead sector panel, a toast on the title bar and several text sizes below the 16px floor.
findings: P0 sector panel (cold storage): Make the panel --ui-panel with a 3px lime left tab. Put the sector name at 32px and a 56px stat (such as '39% extract') under it. Cut the stats line down to 3 short chips. Desaturate the map to the --ui-raised family, with 16px labels at tx-2. Set the panel height to its content (about 240px) and delete the empty strip below it.

P0 option rows (surface, weather, kit, pack): Use tx-1 text on idle buttons and --ui-line-hi borders. For the selected state, use a lime fill with --acc-ink text. Set labels in a fixed 96px column at 16px tx-2. Use 40px-high buttons with 8px gaps. Group surface and weather into one segmented control each.

P1 pack steppers (medkit ... compact smg, no data core): Use a 2-column grid of 48px rows (name left, '- 0 +' right, label 16px/20px). Drop the per-item 'max' since 'pack all' exists. Hide items with none available. Align all columns to the 8px grid.
P1 going-up-with summary box: Cut it to chips: 'scav pistol' plus a --warn glyph with 'no armour' and a --danger glyph with 'no gun'. Use 16px tx-1 for text. Leave lime for the cta only.
P1 top toast 'the welcome pack is in your stash.': Drop it. If a toast stays, put it at the bottom-centre at 16px, 24px above the card edge, on --scrim. Keep it out of the header.

06-terms.verdict: The terms card is still a small, dim column floating in an empty 90% card, with an explaining paragraph, 14px grey row text and a misaligned footer. The intro paragraph grew slightly, but none of the hierarchy, contrast or alignment problems from before were fixed.
findings: P0 whole card: Fill the card: title top-left at 32px in the 56px header row, rows 72px tall on a 24px grid, column 1400px wide. Or build a two-column layout with the terms list on the left and a detail or payout pane (--ui-raised) on the right.
P0 intro paragraph: Delete it. Replace with a 16px label such as 'bonus paid on extract only', or drop it entirely. The row descriptions already explain each term.
P1 rows: name and description: Names 20px f-cond 600 tx-1. Descriptions 16px tx-2. Reward '+25%' at 32px f-cond 700 in --acc, or --ok. Row height 72px.

P1 sign buttons and sign nothing: Buttons 96x48 with 20px text. Give the focused row a --ui-raised fill plus a 3px --acc left bar, and make the focused button an --acc fill with --acc-ink text. Signed rows should show --ok 'signed'.

P1 footer: 'nothing signed' line, divider, sign nothing: Put everything on the list's 431 to 1489 edges. Use 24px between the list and the footer. Put the status line at 16px tx-2 on the left and 'sign nothing' at the right edge on the same baseline, or make it a quiet text button.

07-party-coop.verdict: The copy is shorter and the type is bigger, but the screen is still a small column of text floating in a nearly empty 90 percent card, with no clear main action and no focus state.
findings: P0 whole card, content block at y 380-690: Lay out two columns inside the card. Put a 48px-padded header row at the top with the title left-aligned at 32px and the x on the right. Below it, put a 4-slot party roster on the left and the host and join actions on the right. Alternatively shrink the card to about 60 percent width for this small window.

P0 host a party and join a party buttons, y 575-690: Make host a party a lime --acc fill with --acc-ink text, 48px high and at least 200px wide, with 20px f-cond 700 text. Keep join a party as a quiet outlined button. Draw a visible focus bar on the pad-selected button.

P1 lime status line 'not in a party...' (y 490): Set it in tx-2 at 20px, or replace it with a short status such as 'no party', paired with a small ok or warn glyph. Reserve lime for the host a party button.

P1 join field (564,575 to 1489,643) and join a party button: Put host a party on its own row. Put the join field and join a party button on a second row, with the field 48px high and the button at its right, both with identical heights and top edges. Use 16px gaps between rows.

P1 intro, hint and trade lines (y 453-598): Cut the trade line and the pty1o hint. Reduce the field to a short label 'invite code' at 16px. Keep one line, 'up to four pillagers', at 20px tx-2. Use a consistent 24px gap between blocks.

08-shop.verdict: The shop is a clean, consistent dark card with one lime action and a clear focus tile, but half the grid area is empty, the detail pane has a big dead gap, and the header and footer details are sloppy.
findings: P1 item grid, rows 3 and up (y 590-1000): Make tiles bigger (about 220x210 with a 72px icon) so 9 items fill about 70% of the height. Or shrink the panel to fit its content. Add category filters in the left column only if they are needed.
P1 detail pane, y 480-770: Add a large item icon (about 160px) under the title and move the price block up. Or put the stats in a 2-column block at 20px and anchor the price block 24px below it.

P1 header, top right (900 credits, 0 xp, stash 3,750 bag 0): Show money as '$900' in the same style as the price. Make stash and bag two matching label-over-value pairs with 32px gaps. Drop xp from the shop if it does nothing here. Leave 24px before the X.
P1 bottom toast 'everything here works. cannot say the same for you.': Delete the line. If a hint line must stay, use 14px f-body tx-2 in the footer row, left-aligned inside the card, with no box.
P2 item tiles, price tags: Set all prices to 16px f-cond 600 tx-1. Use --danger for prices the player cannot afford and drop the lime from prices. Keep lime for the focus border only.

09-craft.verdict: The craft grid is clean and readable, but the screen is a top-heavy template with a dead lower half, a cream detail card that clashes with the dark UI, and a header that collides and shows redundant currency.

10-hire.verdict: A tidy but generic grid, undermined by a loud red glitch banner that outranks everything, a washed-out cream detail panel with a disabled-looking Hire button, and duplicated currency and price data.

11-wirt-gambler.verdict: A tidy but generic dark modal with no focal point: the title, two competing boxes and a pile of explanatory text all sit at similar weight, and the buttons look disabled and have no visible pad focus.

12-mainframe-contracts.verdict: it has the right card-and-x structure and a clear lime focus row, but the list is a flat wall of identical rows, the text is tiny and low-contrast for a couch, and the unused detail pane, clipped last row and overlapping toast make it feel unfinished.
findings: P1 contract list rows (left pane): drop the repeated 'standard' tag (show a tag only for hard or elite), set the row name to 20px tx-1 and the pays line to 16px tx-2 (min 4.5:1). Right-align the $ reward at 20px in a fixed column. Raise row height to 72px with 16px padding.
P1 selected row fill: use --ui-raised #1e2225 for the fill, a 4px solid --acc left bar, and tx-1 text. Optionally a 1px --acc-at-40% outline.

P1 bottom of list and toast ('the welcome pack is in your stash.'): fit the list to the card with 24px bottom padding and a fade or scroll indicator on the cut row. Move the toast to 24px above the card edge, outside the border, or inside the safe area, and shorten it or remove it.

P1 detail pane (right): stretch the pane to the full list height, pin the action button to the bottom at 56px tall, and make the progress bar 8px with an --acc fill. Enlarge the reward icon to 56px with a 16px count. State the disabled state in tx-2 with a 1px --ui-line-hi border.

P2 header stats (900 credits, 0 xp, stash 3,750 bag 0): use one pattern for all three: a 20px tx-1 number plus a 16px tx-2 label, 32px gaps. Split stash and bag into two items. Use '$' consistently for money ('$600', not '600 c' and not 'credits' next to '$').

14-mainframe-racks.verdict: The racks column is now centred in the card, but it is a thin strip of five near-identical flat buttons and grey paragraphs in a mostly empty card, with no focal point, no hero and no real primary action.
findings: P0 import-a-friend paragraph: Delete the paragraph. If any hint stays, use a 16px tx-2 label of 4 words or fewer, such as 'import a pillager'.

P0 cost line under 'build a rack': Replace it with four cost chips at 16px in one row or a 2x2 grid, for example 'scrap 0/12', each in tx-1 when held and danger red when short. Remove the prose and the trailing full stops.

P1 whole card: Make '0 of 10 racks' the 56px f-cond 800 hero. Enlarge the cells to 40px tall tiles. Make 'build a rack' the one lime --acc filled button, and render it disabled but readable with a cost chip row beneath it.

P1 layout, 672px column in a 1720px card: Use a two-pane layout. Put the rack grid and actions in a left panel of about 720px and a --ui-raised detail pane on the right showing the array and data core slots. Alternatively fill the card height with a 5x2 rack tile grid at 96px.

P1 build a rack, fold 10 racks into an array, slot a data core: Disabled text should be at least #aaa498 at 70% (4.5:1). Add a 3px lime focus bar plus a --ui-raised fill on the focused row. Set button height to 56px with --fs-body 20px text, not about 14px.

16-bar-last-pour.verdict: a full-size card that is mostly empty, with a small off-centre content block, a title that is too small and doesn't align with the content below it, and two identical lime buttons competing for attention, so it reads as a template rather than a bar menu.
findings: P1 whole card composition: Anchor a 56px header row at the top of the card with the title at left, 32px f-cond 700, 24px padding. Make the list fill the card width, with 72px rows and 16px gaps. Or move the content block up so it starts about 120px below the header.

P1 title 'the last pour' (y≈390): Left-align the title to x=431 and set it at 32px f-cond 700 in tx-1. Remove the short underline, or make it a 2px, 36px-wide accent tab. Add 24px between the title and the body copy.

P1 ingest buttons x2 and the $300/$520 prices: Make the prices tx-1 at 20px. Make the idle buttons outline-only (1px line-hi, tx-1). Fill the focused row's button with lime. Add a --ui-raised row fill and a 3px lime left bar on the focused row.

P1 descriptions and 'things are about to get real.': Delete 'things are about to get real.' and 'you hold $900' since the header already shows the balance. Keep one short effect line per row at 16px in tx-2 (at least 4.5:1). Cut the long blotter sentence to about 6 words.

P2 top-right currency strip: Show '$900' with a 16px label, and use one size and weight for every item. Put 24px between items and a 1px divider before the stash/bag group. Show stash and bag as 'stash $3,750' and 'bag 0' at 16px, in tx-2 on --ui-panel.

17-fashion-mirror.verdict: A competent dark-panel template with a clear two-column layout, but the grid is a wall of near-identical tiles, the operator preview is dwarfed, and the header, footer and list clip or crowd, so it reads as a debug inventory and not a Fortnite-grade fashion screen.

18-settings-hub.verdict: A clean, consistent dark card with a clear lime focus bar and an X, but the page is flat: titles are small, the detail pane is mostly empty with a wall-of-text explanation, and the audio rows are not grouped under their own tab.
findings: P1 right detail pane: Cut the description to one short callout of 12 words or fewer, set at 20px tx-1 directly under the 32px title (8px gap). Or drop the pane to a narrower 360px column and give the freed width to the rows.
P1 center list, the raid tab: Move the volume rows to the audio tab only. If a group stays, add a 16px tx-2 label row ('audio') with a 1px --ui-line rule and 24px space above it.

P1 screen title and header: Set the title to 32px f-cond 700, in a 56px header row with a 1px --ui-line-hi divider. Remove the orphan 30px lime tick at x=28,y=26, or turn it into a deliberate 3px-by-36px tab on the title.

P1 setting value cells (the < value > steppers): Pull the value column in to a 220px block right-aligned at x~1020. Show the chevrons only on the focused row (the rest tx-2 at 40%). Or make each row a single flat value with the arrows on focus.
P2 left tab column: Use 20px f-cond 600 at 64px row height, add a 1px divider above 'send play data', and anchor it to the bottom of the column.

19-raid-hud-drop-first-raid.verdict: The HUD has a sound layout, but it is crowded with at least seven competing blocks, nothing sets the hero number apart, the panel and type styles disagree, and the text is full of typos.
findings: P0 top-right career column, run info panel, bot list, tips and toasts: Find out whether this is the font fallback or the lowercase transform. Use Barlow with a distinct dotted i. Raise the body text to 20px. Proof every string on screen.
P0 overall composition: Hide the controls list after about 10s or show it only on F1. Remove both explaining toasts. Cut the run info text to short chips. Show at most 3 contextual elements at once.

P1 top-right column: credits, xp, stash, backpack, minimap, run info: Use 8px gaps everywhere, including above and below the minimap. Give the minimap a 1px --ui-line-hi border and a 4px radius. Fix the black strip on the right side. Set the stat width to about 220px so labels and values read as pairs, and keep a 24px margin from the edge.

P1 bottom-right ammo card (scav pistol 12 / 24): Keep the 56px 800-weight '12' and make '/ 24' tx-2 at 20px. Drop the gun name to 20px f-cond 600, upright. Move the 'b / i backpack' hint to 16px tx-2 on the belt row. Remove the ghost silhouette, or draw it at 100% so it reads.

P1 top-left bot list, and the run info, controls and toast panels: Use one panel: --ui-panel at 90%, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px padding, a 16px f-cond 600 tx-2 header with a chevron on every collapsible. Use tx-1 for names and keep colour only for the player marker.

21-raid-hud-calm.verdict: The HUD has working pieces (hotbar, ammo hero number, vertical top-right column), but it is crowded, it ignores the style guide's five type sizes and one-accent rule, and the bottom-left and bottom-centre read as unfinished next to the polished ammo card.
findings: P0 bottom-centre controls cheat sheet (wasd/ctrl/lmb... f1 full list): Hide it by default after the first raid, or collapse it to one line ('f1 controls') at 16px. If it must stay, shrink it to 6 essential rows, 16px, tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better, with the key in tx-1 and the action in tx-2, and align it to the 48px margin, not centred over the hotbar.

P1 top-right career column (credits, xp, stash, backpack), minimap and run info: Merge credits, xp, stash and backpack into one panel with 40px rows and 1px --ui-line dividers, values right-aligned in f-cond 600 at 20px. Give the minimap the same 1px --ui-line-hi border and --rad 4px. Redo run info as label (16px tx-2) over value (20px tx-1) rows with one left indent, and put a lime tick or progress pip on each contract.

P1 bottom-right ammo card and hotbar: Set the backpack hint to 16px tx-2. Align the ammo card bottom to the hotbar bottom (both at 1080 minus 32px). Slot numbers go to 16px. Raise empty-slot icons to about 50% opacity. Drop the lime fill on 'fire'; use a tx-1 text pill, and keep lime for the selected slot only.

P1 bottom-left status stack (standing, stamina, hp 100): Put both bars on one 8px-grid column, 320px wide and 24px tall, with a 1px border and --ui-panel backing. Labels sit at 16px in tx-1, left-aligned and vertically centred in the bar, with the value right-aligned. Make the stamina fill a desaturated --extract teal or tx-2. Keep HP as the only strong colour and use --ok green on it. Fix the left margin to 48px, in line with the other corner margins.

P1 top-left scoreboard 'current pillager bots 3': Header text in tx-2 at 16px. Set the margin to 48px (the 5% rule). Highlight the 'you' row with a 3px lime left tab and raised fill. Use the same panel P (1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 24px padding) as the other blocks.

22-raid-map-open.verdict: The window shell (title left, x top-right, centred card, lime m close key) is consistent and clean. The map is still a crowd of tiny labels and the contracts column is a flat list of identical rows, so the eye has no clear first stop. The 'cache' labels now clump into leader-line tangles at the top-right and right-middle.
findings: P1 map, strongbox/blast freezer cluster (x 920-1080, y 360-560): Merge duplicate-type tags into one label with a count, for example 'cache x4'. Keep one leader line per label. Keep the tag column at least 24px clear of the zone and extract labels. Drop the leader lines when the icon is within 40px.
P1 map, top-right (x 960-1060, y 180-290): Combine them into one 'cache x3' label. Put it outside the room rectangle at least 12px from the 'locked' label. Use 16px type.

P1 contracts panel, rows: Draw the progress bar as a 4px track in --ui-line with a --acc fill proportional to progress. Set reward text in --tx-1 and the name in --tx-1 at 20px. Give every row a count in the same slot ('0/1') so 'open' does not break the column.

P1 map labels, overall: Use three tiers: extract labels 20px --extract, point-of-interest labels 16px --tx-1, zone names 16px --tx-2 at 4.5:1 or better. Give POI labels a 1px dark text outline or a 60% --ui-void chip behind them.
P2 map, left edge (old image only; 'codex entry' toast): None needed. Confirm in a later capture that toasts never draw over the window card.

23-raid-backpack-open.verdict: The backpack is a wide, mostly empty dark slab with tiny, low-contrast text and three lonely item slots, and it sits in a HUD cluttered with competing text blocks, so it looks like a debug panel rather than a AAA inventory.

25-raid-pause-box.verdict: A clean, calm pause card with a clear lime primary action and an X in the corner, but it is a small 480px box on a 1920 screen, with a mismatched button stack and a dead gap above a tiny abandon link.
findings: P1 card size vs window rule: Keep it as a compact pause menu if that is the intent, but then state that exception in the guide. Otherwise widen it to about 640px and add a hero title at 32px.
P1 button stack: Make every button 56px with 16px gaps. Make report a problem, feedback and what's new share one equal row of three, or stack all of them at full width.
P1 abandon run: Make it a 56px outlined button with a 1px --danger border and --danger text at 20px. Place it 24px below the secondary rows, or lower it into a footer row.
P2 header: Give the X a 48px square hit area with a --ui-line-hi border on focus. Make the tab 3px high and fully --acc.
P2 secondary button fills: Use one idle fill, transparent or --ui-bg, with a --ui-line-hi border on every non-primary button.

26-settings-from-pause-top.verdict: The new settings window is a huge fix (the old one was a broken, empty header stuck at the bottom of a black screen), and it now reads as a real centred card with tabs, rows and focus. But the content is a narrow column with dead side space, the controls float far from their labels, and the bottom of the list and the footer are crowded and cut off.
findings: P1 row controls (chevron, value, chevron): Right-align the stepper group to the row's right padding (16px). Or cap the row at 900px at 1080 so the label-to-control gap is under 400px. Make the chevrons about 24px with a 48px hit area.

P1 list bottom edge / 'how much is out there' row: Size the list to a whole number of 56px rows (at 4K, 112px each) or add a 24px fade mask at the bottom. Widen the scrollbar to 6-8px, with a visible track, and inset it 8px from the panel edge.
P1 window layout / side margins: Keep the 900px-at-1080 measure but align the title, tabs and footer to the same column. Or fill the card with a left category nav and a right detail pane.

P1 detail pane (edit the words): Drop the repeated title and shrink the pane to one 16px tx-2 line. Replace the copy with something neutral like 'changes the in-game wording'. Align the pane's left padding with the row text at x=522.
P2 tab strip: Use 20px tabs with 24px side padding and a 3px underline. Move 'send play data' into the list as a row, or make it a ghost button, and add LB/RB glyphs at the strip ends.

32-keys-window.verdict: A clean, near-full-screen dark card with an x in the corner that matches the window rule, but a flat wall of same-weight rows, tiny section labels, a long gap between each action and its key, and a half-clipped row at the bottom keep it from looking polished.
findings: P1 list bottom edge, rows 'controls list' / 'order your hire': Fade the list out over the last 24px with a gradient mask, or snap the scroll to whole rows and add 16px bottom padding. Make the scrollbar thumb 6px wide in --ui-line-hi, brightening on focus.

P1 section headers 'move' / 'fight' / 'world': Set the headers to 16px f-cond 700 in tx-2 with +.04em tracking. Make the lime bar 3px wide and match its height to the header text, or span the header plus its first row. Keep 24px above each header and 8px below.

P1 row layout, action name vs key cap: Narrow each column to about 760px and give each row a 1px --ui-line bottom divider, or put the key cap directly after a fixed 360px label column. Add a --ui-raised fill for the focused row.
P1 pad focus / selected state: Draw focus as a 2px --acc border on the cap plus a --ui-raised row fill. Show a 'press a key' state with an --acc-ink on --acc cap. Keep the rest quiet.

P2 title bar 'keys' and x: Remove the stray tick or turn it into a 3px by 36px tab drawn on purpose. Make the header row 56px with the title centred vertically. Put the x in a 44px square with a focus border.

33-raid-fight-alerts.verdict: the closer camera makes the player and nearby threats easier to read, but the screen still drowns the one thing that should win, the pillbox alert, under nine simultaneous panels and a triplicated warning.
findings: P0 top-center alert vs left-side event log vs world tag, 1080 shot: drop the floating world tag (keep it on the pillbox icon only, no duplicate text) and let the event log entries fade after ~3s instead of persisting under an active toast; one alert surface, not three.

P0 bottom-center floating keybind panel, overlaps the walkway between player and pillbox: move this to a corner (e.g. bottom-left under hp/stamina) or collapse it to the "f1 full list" toggle only, so the center of the screen is clear during combat; it already has a caret, so default it collapsed after the first few seconds of a raid.

P1 right edge: credits/xp/stash/backpack stack, minimap, run info panel: demote the stat stack to tx-2 (muted) numbers until they change, keep only --acc on the one number that just updated, and tighten panel padding so the column reads as one unit, not three competing boxes.

P1 world tags "pillbox v-64" and "sentry k-98" compared old vs new shot: pin entity name-tag text to a fixed screen size (e.g. --fs-label, 16px) regardless of camera zoom, same as the style guide's other labels, so zoom changes don't silently drift type scale.
P1 whole 1080 frame: during an active alert, auto-dim or shrink the non-combat panels (bots list, keybind card) to ~60% opacity so the eye has fewer equal-weight boxes to parse.

35-kia-card.verdict: A clean, centred end card that mostly follows the shell (red title, one hero number, row of 4 stats, tile row, one primary), but the hero is a banned '$' figure, the secondary text is tiny and dim, and the item tiles are too small and confusingly placed above the number.

38-extracted-card.verdict: solid use of the palette and type scale but it ships two real couch-play gaps: no visible pad focus and unlabeled loot icons.
findings: P1 log run and return button, bottom of card: add a 2-3px --acc outline or --acc-hover fill on the default-focused button so pad focus is visible at 1080 from a couch.
P1 5-icon loot row under the objective text: add a 14px --fs-fine label or count badge (e.g. "x2") under or on each icon, matching the row-name convention used elsewhere in the guide.

P2 'burst carbine recovered to the armoury' line, directly under the checkmarked objective: either give it its own icon/glyph (e.g. a small armoury icon) or drop it to --fs-label/tx-2 weight so it stops competing with the real checkmarked objective.

P2 bottom border under icon 1 (blue) and icon 2 (green) in the loot row: apply the 3px rarity bar from the style guide to every item consistently, or remove it from all five if rarity isn't meaningful here.
P2 card frame, overall: either widen the card toward the guide's standard proportions or add a deliberate secondary element (a thin side rail, map thumbnail) to justify the negative space.

40-whats-new-card.verdict: cleaner than the five-note version but the card ignores the window spec's 90%-width rule and triples up on dismiss controls.
findings: P1 whats-new card, 13-t1 shot: widen the card to 90% of viewport width (about 1728px at 1920x1080) per section 2 of the guide, reflow the three notes into the wider card instead of a narrow column

P1 card footer, bottom-left and bottom-right: keep the corner x plus the single live prompt ('press enter or walk to dismiss'); drop the 'got it' fill button so there is one explicit close (x) and one ambient prompt, not three
P2 top-right corner of the card, the x glyph: draw the x in --tx-1 (#efe9dc) or --acc on hover/focus, not a dim grey, so it reads at 15:1 like the rest of the UI
P2 left edge accent tab: redraw the left tab at exactly 3px per the component spec so it reads as a tab, not a stripe

45-arcade-attract-board.verdict: The card is clean and all lower case, but it is unchanged from the last review: the empty body is centered, the prompt is a dim ring-and-text with no real focus state, and the small card is neither a proper dialog nor a window.
findings: P1 'press any key' prompt, bottom-right of card (1065-1206 x 605-628): Make it a 56px-high primary button with fill #e6ff3d, text #11150a at 20px/700, min-width 200px, right-aligned 24px from the card edge. Or use tx-1 text with a 3px #e6ff3d underline and drop the ring.

P1 card body, 'no scores yet' (x≈906-1014, y≈534): Left-align it at x=714 in tx-2, 20px/400, 24px below the header. Add 3 dim placeholder rows at a 56px pitch ('1 ---', '2 ---', '3 ---') with 1px #2e3337 dividers.

P1 card structure (682-1238 x 412-667): Choose one. For a dialog, make it 480x240 with 24px padding. For a window, make it 90% wide and tall with a 56px header and a 72px footer holding the primary on the right.
P2 close X, top-right of card (1167-1215 x 430-476): Use a 1px #4a5257 border, a 20px close glyph in tx-2, and a 'B' glyph 8px to its left. Inset it 24px from the top and right edges.
P2 'pillagers' wordmark, top-left (96-210 x 60-88): Set it in tx-2 at 70% opacity, or remove it. If kept, use 32px with a 36px lime tab above it, aligned to x=96.

50-arcade-hud-live.verdict: The raid HUD is readable and uses lime and teal sensibly, but it is built from loose, mismatched boxes of different sizes, fills and edge treatments, and some of its small text is too small for a couch.

70-settings-sec-controls.verdict: The detail pane is now flat, but the settings card still has the same weaknesses as before: a narrow 960px column floating in a 1870px card, steppers stranded mid-row, tiny low-contrast tabs, and a list that is clipped mid-row.

Move 'send play data' into the list as a row or into the footer. Add lb/rb glyphs at the strip ends.

P2 bottom of the list, 'stick deadzone' row (y≈825): Snap the viewport to whole rows (for example 10 × 56px = 560px), or add a 24px gradient mask at the bottom. Make the scrollbar 6px in --ui-line-hi and brighter on focus.

P2 detail pane (keys / rebind...), y≈860-978: Put a 1px --ui-line-hi border and --ui-panel fill back at 24px padding, with an 8px gap above the pane. Use a 20px tx-1 title and a 16px tx-2 body trimmed to one short clause, e.g. 'rebind any action; conflicts swap'.

76-haul-reveal-mid.verdict: the haul reveal reads clean at a glance but contradicts its own success check and is missing half the component polish the style guide requires.
findings: P0 objective line vs haul number: gate the checkmark on the actual haul total (haul >= 1200) or drop the objective line when it was not met; never show a check next to a number that contradicts it.
P1 xp line under the title, 'extracted': relabel to 'sp' if this is the score track, or get an explicit ruling from the owner before shipping a new 'xp' currency distinct from $ and sp.

P1 item grid, rows under the recovered-weapons lines: collapse the grid to only the slots that hold items (pack them left-to-right, no empty cells), or if empty slots are intentional capacity indicators, dim them further and add a consistent dashed outline so they read as 'empty' and not 'missing render'.
P1 item icon slots: add the 3px rarity-color bottom or left bar from the token set to every filled slot so the grid matches the Diablo-style rarity read the guide specifies.

P2 'first out . heavy haul . untouched . ghost' row: render each as a small pill/tag (1px --ui-line-hi border, --rad corners, --fs-label text) so they read as discrete earned badges, not a sentence fragment.

75-settings-pad-rebind-waiting.verdict: the waiting chip now reads cleanly as the one lime thing (image 2 calms the banner to a raised fill with a thin lime tab), but the screen is still a flat wall of same-weight 16px text with a left-heavy offset layout, a faded half-row at the bottom, and a footer that strands 'esc close' in the corner.
findings: P1 banner 'press a button for sprint · esc cancels': keep the image 2 treatment (--ui-raised fill) with a 3px --acc tab, set text to 20px tx-1, and cut it to 'press a button for sprint'. Move 'esc cancels' to the footer legend at 16px tx-2, and show 'b cancel' on pad.

P1 list rows and chips (all categories): category labels 16px tx-2 uppercase-free with +.04em tracking, no bold. Action names 20px tx-1 weight 600. Idle chips use --ui-raised fill and a --ui-line border. Keep --acc only on the waiting chip.

P1 bottom of list, 'world' row (ping, pause): snap the scroll so the focused row is fully visible, or add a 24px gradient mask to --ui-panel. Make the scrollbar 6px --ui-line-hi, with the thumb in tx-2.

P2 left edge alignment: pick one left edge: align the banner and list to x=49 with the title, or centre a 1440px column and align the title to it. Align category labels and action names to the same inset.

P2 footer 'reset to defaults' and 'esc close': make one 72px footer row: reset on the left, and on the right a legend 'b close · y reset' at 16px tx-2 with pad glyphs. Both items are vertically centred on the same line.

72-settings-sec-display.verdict: the settings card is clean, consistent and all lower case, but the detail pane is a huge empty box, the stepper columns float mid-row, and the list is cut off at the bottom, so it still reads as a template options screen.
findings: P1 right detail pane (x=1088-1870, y=116-994): Narrow the pane to about 420px and give the freed width to the list. Or keep it full height and add a 56px f-cond 800 hero readout of the current value ('full') in --acc under the 32px title. Put the description 24px below the title at 20px f-body tx-1 and top-align it.

P1 stepper columns (chevrons x≈731 and x≈982, value x≈857, row x=338-1046): Right-align the cluster to the row edge: chevrons at x≈1000 and x≈1030 with a 160px value cell centred between them. Or shrink the list column to about 560px. Make the chevrons 20px, with tx-2 when idle and --acc when the row is focused.

P1 list bottom (rows 'crosshair' and 'crosshair colour', y≈900-994): End the viewport on a multiple of the 56px row height (for example y=952), 16px above the footer. Limit the fade to the last 24px. Make the thumb 6px wide in --ui-line-hi, inset 8px from the border, with a visible track.

P1 left rail (x=50-313) idle items and 'send play data' (y=555): Set idle items to 20px f-cond 600 tx-2 and the selected item to tx-1 on --ui-raised. Add a 1px --ui-line divider and 24px of space above 'send play data', and mark it as a utility link in 16px tx-2.

P2 focused row 'render resolution' (x=338-1046, y=117-171) and the detail pane top edge (y=116): Inset the list 8px from the top, or add a 1px --ui-line gap. Make the pane's top tab 36px wide, not full-width, so only the focused row carries the strong lime.

74-settings-change-pad-buttons.verdict: The pad picture is now calmer: leader lines end on dots on the actual buttons and the lime on every label is gone. But the left rows and the picture are still two competing lists, and the screen has no clear first read or focus state.
findings: P1 left list, binding column: Set chip text to 16px f-cond 600 in tx-1. Make the chips 56px wide by 40px tall with a 1px --ui-line-hi border. Show the focused row with a --ui-raised fill and a 3px lime left bar, and the focused chip with a lime border.

P1 controller diagram, button labels: Set prefixes to --tx-2 (#aaa498) at 18px or larger, and actions to tx-1. Make leader lines 1.5px --ui-line-hi. Make the dots 6px solid tx-1. Use lime only for the one hovered or focused binding, not for all of them.

P1 the screen as a whole: Make the list the editor and the picture a read-only legend, or split the screen 40/60 and drop the picture's labels to 16px. Add a 24px fade or bottom padding so the last row is never sliced. Tighten the layout row from about 96px to 64px.

P2 picture, left label stack: Order the left labels top to bottom by the controller part they point to (lt, lb, view, ls, d-pad). Space them on a 56px rhythm with leader endpoints aligned to each label's centre line.
P2 category headers 'move' / 'fight': Set headers to 16px f-cond 700 in tx-2 with a 1px divider above them. Drop the lime bar, or keep it only on the active section.

01-title-mode-menu.verdict: The column menu is clean and the lime focus bar reads well, but the orange gradient title breaks the palette, the 5-mode list is cluttered, and the save block is crowded and tiny.
findings: P1 title wordmark 'pillagers': Flatten the title to --tx-1 (#efe9dc), f-cond 800, 56px hero size, no gradient, no shadow. Keep lime only on the focused row.
P1 mode list (5 rows): Cut the 'coming later' row, merge the arcade demos into one row or order the list by purpose. Max 3 or 4 rows, 56px pitch.

P1 saves block (saves label, pillager new row, name field, change name, create a new save): Drop the save row text to tx-1 with only a 3px lime left tab for focus. Put change name and create a new save behind one 'manage saves' row, or on a second line at 16px minimum. Use 24px between the mode list and saves.
P1 'coming later' disabled row: Remove it. If it stays, label text is --tx-2 at least and the tag is 16px.

44-title-from-character-select.verdict: The title screen has a clear lime primary button, but the orange-gold gradient logo fights it, the trophy toast overlaps and hides the key-hint legend, and there are capitals on screen, a stacked menu and a saves block with no clear structure.
findings: P0 bottom centre: trophy toast over key-hint legend: Move the toast to the top-centre or the bottom-right, at least 24px clear of the legend (e.g. y=96px). Or lift the legend 56px. Never overlap them.
P0 name field 'PILLAGER': Render the value with text-transform:lowercase and use 'pillager' as the default. Add a 16px tx-2 label 'name'.
P1 'pillagers' logo: Make the logo flat --tx-1 at 800 weight (~96px), or flat --acc. Remove the gradient and shadow so the lime '1 player' button is the only hot element.

P1 menu stack and saves block: Put the menu and saves in one centred 640px column on a 90% --ui-panel with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 24px padding. Use a 56px row pitch with 8px gaps. Give 'saves' a 16px f-cond 600 tx-2 label with a 1px divider.

90-legend-full.verdict: The new version only adds a superhot toggle row to the key legend and trims a few lines of copy; the legend is still a big, dense, tiny-text wall that sits over the middle of the playfield and fights with every HUD element.

Cut it to the ~12 essential bindings. Use --ui-panel at 90% with a 1px --ui-line-hi border and 24px padding.

undefined legend text size and contrast: Set rows to 20px (minimum 16px). Key chips in tx-1 with a --ui-raised fill and 1px --ui-line. Descriptions in tx-2 at ≥4.5:1. Section heads at 16px with +.04em tracking in --acc or tx-1, not amber (--warn is for warnings only). Raise the fill to --scrim .80+ so the map does not show through.

undefined legend column alignment and new last row: Render the backtick as a key chip like the others. Add 1px --ui-line dividers on a 48px row pitch. Keep 8px grid spacing between sections. Move 'f1 hide' into a 16px footer legend with a pad glyph.

undefined HUD colour and weight consistency (pillagers list, run info, concealed tag, codex toast): Map every accent to a token: lime --acc for focus only, --warn for warnings, --extract for extraction. Pull the label out from behind the minimap or clip it cleanly. Cap the HUD to the 5-size scale. Dim or hide the legend's backdrop competition.

undefined run info panel (right, 1585-1900 x 305-445): Use one panel style (same title colour and size for both panels). 16px padding on all sides. Give each objective row a 32px pitch with the count right-aligned in tx-2. Make the chevron ≥24px.

92-settings-superhot-pane.verdict: The window shell is right (centred card, title top-left, X top-right), but the pane is a flat, same-weight list with a clipped row, a mixed-up tab strip and an explanation block, so it reads as an unfinished template.

Remove the audio rows from the 'the raid' group. Add a visible scrollbar track 4px wide spanning the full list height, or a fade at the bottom edge.

P0 detail pane at bottom ('superhot mode / time only moves when you act. / key: `(left of 1)'): Show the description only for the focused row, as a single 16px tx-2 line. P1 tab strip ('the raid / audio / controls / controller / display / accessibility' + 'send play data'): Move 'send play data' to the footer as a ghost button or into its own tab content. Set tabs at 20px/600 with 24px side padding and a 48px height. Add LB/RB glyphs at the strip ends.

P1 window card (outer frame) and the centred 960px column: Either widen the list to max 900px with a 5% margin and add a left category rail, or keep the 960px column and drop the full-width dividers. Place the 36px lime top tab inside the header, aligned to the title, or delete it.

60-mapfirst-1p.verdict: the map screen has gone from a blue-purple debug overlay to a proper dark centred card with a title bar, contracts list, footer and one lime main action, and the remaining faults are label collisions around the east blocks and uneven contract rows.

P2 map labels: 'hot ground', 'encampment' x2, 'extract a' and 'closes in 5:00': Set these labels to 16px/600 with a 2px #0b0c0d halo, or switch 'hot ground' to #efe9dc beside the 20px warn glyph. 91-snip-panel-raid.verdict: The lime frame, size tag and copy/save actions are clearer than before, but the whole HUD is still at full strength, the controls cheat-sheet still collides with the frame, and the selection is still washed in blue, so it reads as a debug overlay rather than a polished snip mode.

P1 copy / save action box (942-1239, 728-802): Drop the outer box and keep the two buttons only. Use 20px 700 labels, 56px high, 16px below the frame, right-aligned to it. Make save transparent with a 1px #4a5257 border. Add a 2px lime focus ring with a 2px offset.
P2 size tag '720 x 420 px' (520-630, 264-292): Use the panel component: --ui-panel fill, 1px --ui-line-hi border, 4px radius, 16px f-cond 600 text. Sit it flush on the frame's top-left edge. Use '×'.

20-raid-hud-drop.verdict: the closer camera reads fine but it did nothing for the real problem: the hud is still a pile of mismatched boxes fighting each other for the eye.

34-raid-downed-pickups.verdict: the downed plate is now a contained dark card and the career row is a vertical list, but the right column is a crowded stack where the pickup feed, run info, 'extraction available' and the 'concealed' tag overlap each other, and the timer is still not the hero.
findings: P0 right column: run info, pickup feed, 'extraction available', 'concealed · in cover' tag: stack the right column top to bottom with a fixed 16px gap and a 48px right margin: career list, minimap at about 240px tall, run info, then status. Move the pickup feed out of this column to a separate anchor (above the weapon panel, right-aligned). Give 'extraction available' its own 24px row and drop the concealed tag to its own row or into the weapon panel.

P1 left pickup feed, contract toast and world labels: keep one feed, right-aligned, 3 rows with a 32px row height and an 8px gap, and delete the left one. Use a face where lower-case 'l' and 'i' are distinct. Give world labels a 1px dark outline at tx-1 and a 16px minimum.

36-raid-low-health.verdict: The low-health state reads clearly from the red vignette and the hp bar, but the HUD around it is cluttered: panels differ in style, text sizes are mixed, there are several overlapping layers, and it looks like a debug overlay more than a shipped raid HUD.
findings: P0 top-right career stack (credits, xp, stash, backpack) plus minimap and run info: Cut the stack to two compact items (backpack value and one more) of about 24px height each, or move them into the tab or inventory view. Rename 'credits' to a '$' value. Drop the repeat of the 2,170 figure. Right-align to a 5% margin (96px) and use 8px gaps.

P0 centre-bottom controls cheat sheet (wasd / ctrl / lmb ... f1 full list): Show it only for the first run or on hold of f1. Remove it from the default raid view. If it stays, cut it to 4 essentials at 16px with tx-1 keys and tx-2 actions.

P1 hp bar and stamina bar (bottom-left): Make the hp bar 12px taller with one flat style. Use a danger fill (#e5482f) over a dark track, a 56px hero number, and a pulse below 25 hp. Make stamina a thin 6px bar, and drop the 'standing' tag or turn it into a small glyph. Align the three to the left 48px margin.

P1 panel styling across the screen (pillager bots list, run info, key list, ammo card, hotbar): Use one panel: --ui-panel at 90%, a 1px --ui-line-hi border, a 4px radius and 16px padding. Titles use tx-2 at 16px. Reserve the lime accent for focus and the main action. Turn the amber callouts into warn-coloured text or plain tx-1.

P1 scattered callouts (extract 152m, running slowly x2, codex entry, concealed · in cover): Show a status callout once, in one slot (a 24px strip under the timer). Use one pill style at 16px and 8px padding. Put toasts in a single stack at bottom-left. Fix the clipping of 'concealed · in cover' with a 48px right margin and remove the ghost text. Keep the timer at the 56px hero size with a dark backing.

51-arcade-alert-reinforcements.verdict: The HUD is still a pile of different-looking widgets: pillager reinforcements shows twice (top pill and left log), the left log is a stack of mismatched pills, and the score, minimap, vitals and ammo panels share no common panel, type scale or padding.
findings: P0 top-centre 'pillager reinforcements' pill plus left event log (both shots): Show a live alert only in the top card. Log only older events, max 3 rows. Delete 'machine has you in sight'. Remove the duplicate pill.

P0 left event log: rain / blackout, stronghold, golden enemy, pillager reinforcements: One row component: fixed 320px wide, 32px high, --ui-panel at 90%, 3px left bar (--warn for info, --danger for threat), 16px f-cond 600 tx-1 text, 8px gap between rows, max 3 rows with older ones fading out. Drop the info icons.

P1 top-right minimap + 'run info' panel: Drop 'run info'. Make 'run goals' a 16px tx-2 label, goal names 20px tx-1, rewards right-aligned in tx-2. Use 16px padding, a 1px --ui-line divider between rows, an 8px gap below the minimap and a 24px margin from the screen edge.
P1 top-centre score block (0 sp / 9:45 / extract 113m): One Panel P, 16px from the top, containing the 56px f-cond 800 timer, a 20px score and the 16px --extract line with the arrow attached to it.

P1 bottom-left vitals (standing, armour, stamina, hp): Three bars, each 20px high with 8px gaps. Put the 16px label inside the left edge and the value on the right. Use --ok for hp, --extract for stamina and a neutral for armour. Make 'standing' a plain 16px tx-2 label above the bars. Render the damage chip as a tx-1 number.

78-raid-pause-box-full-kit.verdict: A clean, calm column menu with one lime primary and a quiet red abandon, so the hierarchy reads, but it is a small generic dialog that ignores the card rule and leaves the bottom of the panel and the type scale unresolved.
findings: P1 whole card: Keep it a compact modal but make it deliberate: widen to 560px, sit it on the 8px grid, add the 3px lime left tab to the panel, and put a one-line run status in the header (time, $ in bag) so the pause shows something. Or leave it small and record it as the one allowed exception in the guide.
P1 button type sizes: Set all button text to 20px f-cond 600 (feedback and what's new at least 16px). Make the half-width buttons 56px tall like the full-width ones, not 48px.

P1 button group hierarchy: Merge feedback and report a problem into one 'report' control, or put feedback and what's new together as a quiet footer pair at 16px. Keep exactly two full-width buttons under resume: settings and one other.
P2 abandon run: Give it a 56px outline button with a 1px danger border (rgba of #e5482f at 60%) and danger text at 20px. Keep it 32px below the group. Lighten the red slightly to #ee5a40 for 4.5:1.
P2 vertical spacing: Use a 16px gap between all buttons, a 32px gap before abandon, and 24px bottom padding so the card ends 24px below abandon.
